title: Margaret Hamilton has died
summary:
Margaret Hamilton, the profoundly influential computer scientist who led the software engineering team for NASA's Apollo program, died on September 30 at the age of 90. Her team at MIT's Instrumentation Lab developed the groundbreaking on-board flight software that successfully landed humans on the moon.

Hamilton was a pioneer in establishing software engineering as a dedicated discipline, coining the term herself. Her innovations included "defensive programming," which anticipated and mitigated errors, famously preventing a mission abort during Apollo 11's lunar landing by prioritizing critical tasks. She worked at MIT from 1959 until the mid-1970s, then became a successful entrepreneur, founding Higher Order Software and Hamilton Technologies, and developing the Universal Systems Language (USL).

Her remarkable career earned her numerous accolades, including the 2016 Presidential Medal of Freedom from President Barack Obama. She was also recognized with the NASA Exceptional Space Act Award, inducted into the National Aviation Hall of Fame, and became an icon for women in STEM, even inspiring a Lego Minifigure. Hamilton's legacy continues to inspire generations, having fundamentally shaped computer science and space exploration. She is survived by her daughter and extended family.
chinese_title: 玛格丽特·汉密尔顿去世了
chinese_summary:
玛格丽特·汉密尔顿（Margaret Hamilton），这位曾领导美国国家航空航天局（NASA）阿波罗计划软件工程团队的极具影响力的计算机科学家，于9月30日去世，享年90岁。她在麻省理工学院（MIT）仪器实验室的团队开发了开创性的机载飞行软件，成功将人类送上月球。

汉密尔顿是将软件工程确立为一门独立学科的先驱，并亲自创造了“软件工程”一词。她的创新包括“防御性编程”，能够预测并减轻错误，最著名的是在阿波罗11号登月任务期间，通过优先处理关键任务，成功防止了一次任务中止。她从1959年到1970年代中期在麻省理工学院工作，之后成为一名成功的企业家，创立了Higher Order Software公司和Hamilton Technologies公司，并开发了通用系统语言（USL）。

她非凡的职业生涯为她赢得了无数赞誉，包括2016年由贝拉克·奥巴马总统授予的总统自由勋章。她还获得了美国国家航空航天局（NASA）杰出空间法案奖，入选国家航空名人堂，并成为STEM领域女性的典范，甚至启发了乐高迷你人偶的设计。汉密尔顿的遗产继续激励着一代又一代人，深刻地塑造了计算机科学和太空探索。她身后留下了她的女儿和大家庭。

title: Claude Haiku 5.5
summary:
Anthropic has released Claude Haiku 5.5, touted as its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model to date. Designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summaries, classification, database queries, and live customer support, Haiku 5.5 offers significant improvements over its predecessor.

It now costs approximately 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5, with a 90% price reduction for prompts up to 100,000 tokens. Benchmarks show superior performance in knowledge work, computer use (e.g., OSWorld 2.1), multidisciplinary reasoning, and agentic coding, and it's the first Haiku-class model with adjustable effort settings. Customer testimonials praise its speed, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness for various enterprise applications.

Safety and alignment have also seen major improvements, with fewer instances of misaligned behavior and more restrictive cybersecurity safeguards. Haiku 5.5 is available across all major platforms.

Accompanying this launch, Anthropic has halved the price of Claude Sonnet 5.5's cache reads, making it about 20% cheaper for most agentic work. Additionally, Max and Team subscribers will receive new monthly API credits to support building agents and applications on the Claude Platform. SDKs are also updated to support computer and browser use in beta, tasks well-suited for Haiku 5.5.
chinese_title: 克劳德 俳句 5.5
chinese_summary:
Anthropic 发布了 Claude Haiku 5.5，被誉为迄今为止最便宜、最快、功能最强的小型模型。Haiku 5.5 专为摘要、分类、数据库查询和实时客户支持等高流量、成本敏感型任务而设计，相比其前代产品有了显著改进。

现在运行它的成本比 Haiku 4.5 降低了约 75%，对于高达 100,000 token 的提示词，价格降低了 90%。基准测试显示，它在知识工作、计算机使用（例如 OSWorld 2.1）、多学科推理和智能体编码方面表现卓越，并且是首个具有可调工作量设置的 Haiku 级别模型。客户评价赞扬其在各种企业应用中的速度、准确性和成本效益。

安全性和对齐性也得到了显著改进，错位行为的实例减少，网络安全保障措施更加严格。Haiku 5.5 已在所有主流平台上线。

伴随此次发布，Anthropic 将 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格减半，使其在大多数智能体工作中便宜约 20%。此外，Max 和 Team 订阅用户将获得新的每月 API 积分，以支持在 Claude 平台上构建智能体和应用程序。SDK 也已更新，以支持计算机和浏览器使用的测试版功能，这些任务非常适合 Haiku 5.5。

title: GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
summary:
On October 7, 2026, OpenAI announced the wider release of GPT-6, bringing its next generation of intelligence to over 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users.

A key innovation is "Intelligent UI," which enables ChatGPT to generate fully interactive user interfaces within its responses. This allows for more visual answers, simplifies learning complex topics through interactive diagrams, and facilitates the creation of instant tools like calculators or games directly in the conversation. GPT-6 leverages a component library and compiler to design adaptive interfaces, combining text, visuals, and interactive elements based on the user's query.

GPT-6 also introduces "Frontier Intelligence," significantly speeding up response times by interleaving thinking with answering. This means ChatGPT can progressively compose answers, delivering information faster, especially for complex tasks and web searches, while maintaining or improving quality.

Safety has been a core focus, with GPT-6 building on Astra's advances. It shows improved resistance to safety bypass attempts, better recognizes real-world risks, responds more honestly, and clearly communicates its capabilities and limitations.

The rollout begins today for ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers (powered by GPT-6 Sol), expanding to Free and Go tiers (powered by GPT-6 Luna) tomorrow. This release marks a step towards a future where software adapts to people, with ChatGPT shaping interfaces around user needs.
chinese_title: GPT‑6 和 智能 UI 普惠大众
chinese_summary:
2026年10月7日，OpenAI宣布GPT-6全面发布，将其下一代智能带给超过12亿周活ChatGPT用户。

一项关键创新是“智能UI”，它使ChatGPT能够在回复中生成完全交互式的用户界面。这使得答案更具视觉性，通过交互式图表简化复杂主题的学习，并便于在对话中直接创建计算器或游戏等即时工具。GPT-6利用组件库和编译器来设计自适应界面，根据用户的查询将文本、视觉元素和交互元素相结合。

GPT-6还引入了“前沿智能”，通过将思考与回答交织进行，显著加快了响应时间。这意味着ChatGPT可以渐进式地构建答案，更快地提供信息，尤其对于复杂任务和网络搜索，同时保持或提高质量。

安全一直是核心重点，GPT-6借鉴了Astra的进展。它显示出对安全绕过尝试更强的抵抗力，更好地识别现实世界风险，更诚实地回应，并清晰地传达其能力和局限性。

此次发布今天开始面向ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business和Enterprise层级（由GPT-6 Sol提供支持）推出，明天将扩展到Free和Go层级（由GPT-6 Luna提供支持）。此次发布标志着向一个软件适应人类的未来迈进，ChatGPT将根据用户需求塑造界面。

title: Show HN: Bigwords.page – Turn any screen into a sign. The URL is the app
summary:
Bigwords.page is a web application that instantly transforms any screen into a customizable full-screen sign, timer, or message, entirely through a URL. It operates on a "no account, no app, nothing stored on a server" principle, making it private and portable, as all display information is embedded within the URL fragment and never sent to a server.

Users can create signs for diverse applications, including arrival greetings, quiz timers, Wi-Fi password displays (with QR codes), room signs, news tickers, and event countdowns. The platform offers extensive customization: text styling via Markdown, adjustable background and foreground colors, various fonts, and animations. Messages can be split into rotating slides, and dynamic countdowns can be set for specific durations or dates. It also supports embedding QR codes for links, Wi-Fi details, and even custom images.

Text automatically adjusts to fill any screen size, from mobile phones to smart TVs, and works across all browsers. To create a sign, users simply add their message after `bigwords.page/#` in the URL, and further customize it with `&key=value` parameters for settings like colors, fonts, and timers.

title: Visa, Mastercard, major banks facing new litigation over 'anticompetitive' fees
summary:
A new class action lawsuit, *The Pizza Standard LLC v. Visa Inc. et al.*, has been filed, accusing Visa, Mastercard, and several major U.S. banks (including Bank of America, Capital One, Chase Bank, Citibank, and Wells Fargo) of conspiring to artificially inflate credit card transaction fees. Filed under the Sherman Antitrust Act, the lawsuit alleges that these financial giants impose "a deadweight toll" on virtually every credit card purchase, resulting in over $100 billion annually in "monopoly rents" paid by merchants.

The complaint contends that the defendants work together to set uniform, non-negotiable "interchange fees" and maintain a "web of anticompetitive rules." These rules allegedly force merchants to accept all Visa and Mastercard credit cards, regardless of cost, thereby eliminating competition among issuing banks to lower fees. Merchants are also reportedly prevented from directing customers to cheaper payment alternatives. The lawsuit claims Visa and Mastercard further exploit these restraints to inflate their own network fees.

This litigation follows a 2019 class action settlement that provided over $5 billion to merchants but only covered fees up to January 24, 2019. The new lawsuit seeks compensation for merchants who have borne the brunt of these allegedly inflated fees from January 25, 2019, onward, arguing that the prior settlement left millions without a remedy for ongoing financial injuries. The proposed class includes all entities that accepted Visa or Mastercard credit cards in the U.S. since January 25, 2019.
chinese_title: 维萨、万事达卡和主要银行因“反竞争”费用面临新诉讼
chinese_summary:
新一起集体诉讼，*The Pizza Standard LLC 诉 Visa Inc. 等案*，已被提起，指控Visa、万事达卡以及多家美国主要银行（包括美国银行、第一资本、摩根大通银行、花旗银行和富国银行）合谋人为抬高信用卡交易费用。该诉讼依据《谢尔曼反垄断法》提起，声称这些金融巨头几乎对每笔信用卡交易都征收“沉重费用”，导致商家每年支付超过1000亿美元的“垄断租金”。

诉状指出，被告合谋设定统一且不可协商的“交换费”，并维持一个“反竞争规则网络”。据称，这些规则强制商家接受所有Visa和万事达卡信用卡，无论成本高低，从而消除了发卡银行之间降低费用的竞争。据报道，商家还被禁止引导顾客选择更便宜的支付替代方案。该诉讼声称，Visa和万事达卡进一步利用这些限制来抬高其自身的网络费用。

此番诉讼是在2019年一项集体诉讼和解协议之后提起的，该协议向商家提供了超过50亿美元的赔偿，但仅涵盖截至2019年1月24日的费用。新诉讼旨在为自2019年1月25日以来一直承受这些据称被抬高费用的商家寻求赔偿，理由是先前的和解协议未能为数百万商家解决持续的财务损害。拟议的集体诉讼成员包括自2019年1月25日以来在美国接受Visa或万事达卡信用卡的所有实体。

title: “Math 2.0” will need to value mathematical progress more holistically
summary:
The article, titled "Math 2.0," argues for a fundamental shift in how mathematical progress is valued. It posits that "Math 2.0" will necessitate a more holistic approach to understanding and appreciating advancements in the field.

This proposed evolution is contrasted with "Math 1.0," which, as noted by Terence Tao in a Mathstodon post, "placed a premium on being the first to…" an achievement. The core message is that the mathematical community needs to move beyond solely prioritizing initial discovery or novelty, embracing a broader, more comprehensive perspective on what constitutes valuable progress.
chinese_title: “数学2.0”将需要更全面地重视数学进步。
chinese_summary:
这篇题为“数学2.0”的文章，主张在评估数学进步的方式上进行根本性转变。它提出，“数学2.0”将需要一种更全面的方法来理解和欣赏该领域的进展。

这种拟议的演变与“数学1.0”形成对比，正如陶哲轩在Mathstodon帖子中指出的那样，“数学1.0”强调“抢占先机”以取得一项成就。其核心信息是，数学界需要超越仅仅优先考虑最初的发现或新颖性，转而采纳一种更广阔、更全面的视角来界定有价值的进步。

title: Shipping JPEG XL in Chrome
summary:
Chrome 155, available October 6, 2026, will support JPEG XL (.jxl) image decoding, a next-generation format offering 30-50% better compression than JPEG. It supports lossless compression, HDR, and lossless JPEG transcoding, making it ideal for high-fidelity photography and progressive decoding.

The decision to ship JPEG XL was driven by three core pillars: security, performance, and significant developer feedback.

To prioritize security, Chrome integrated `jxl-rs`, a pure Rust re-implementation of the JPEG XL decoder. This eliminates common memory safety vulnerabilities (like buffer overflows and use-after-free bugs) frequently found in C++ decoders, bolstering the browser's defense against attacks.

For performance, `jxl-rs` achieves speeds comparable to non-memory-safe alternatives by leveraging modern SIMD hardware through Rust's `target_feature_11` and a `jxl_simd` abstraction layer. Extensive testing, including fuzzing and AI code review, has confirmed its safety and efficiency, with no memory safety bugs found.

Finally, consistent developer demand, expressed through various feedback channels and prominently in the Interop 2026 project, played a crucial role. Chrome is actively participating in the Interop 2026 JPEG XL survey to ensure robust cross-browser interoperability.

Developers are encouraged to begin using .jxl images and animations to contribute to a faster, richer, and more secure web.
chinese_title: 在 Chrome 中推出 JPEG XL
chinese_summary:
Chrome 155 版本将于 2026 年 10 月 6 日发布，届时将支持 JPEG XL (.jxl) 图像解码。这是一种下一代格式，与 JPEG 相比可提供 30-50% 更高的压缩率。它支持无损压缩、HDR 和无损 JPEG 转码，使其成为高保真摄影和渐进式解码的理想选择。

推出 JPEG XL 的决定主要基于三个核心支柱：安全性、性能以及重要的开发者反馈。

为优先考虑安全性，Chrome 集成了 `jxl-rs`，这是一个纯 Rust 语言重新实现的 JPEG XL 解码器。这消除了 C++ 解码器中常见的内存安全漏洞（如缓冲区溢出和释放后使用漏洞），从而增强了浏览器抵御攻击的能力。

在性能方面，`jxl-rs` 通过利用 Rust 的 `target_feature_11` 和 `jxl_simd` 抽象层，借助现代 SIMD 硬件，实现了与非内存安全替代方案相媲美的速度。广泛的测试，包括模糊测试和 AI 代码审查，已证实其安全性和效率，未发现任何内存安全漏洞。

最后，开发者通过各种反馈渠道（特别是在 Interop 2026 项目中）表达的持续需求也发挥了关键作用。Chrome 正在积极参与 Interop 2026 JPEG XL 调查，以确保强大的跨浏览器互操作性。

鼓励开发者开始使用 .jxl 图像和动画，为更快、更丰富、更安全的网络做出贡献。
